title: Copyright Deadlock (The Jimquisition)
summary: A Jimquisition episode by Jim Sterling demonstrating the Copyright Deadlock, where a video includes footage owned by several companies so that competing YouTube Content ID claims cancel each other out. It highlights how absurd the system is.
why: HN cites it as the clearest explanation of how broken Content ID is and of the deadlock trick for defeating forced monetization.

quote.text: Jim Sterling has done a brilliant job at explaining how broken the YouTube Content ID system is
